sources.games: 839 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 50.1%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py centaur_warrunner.
sources.hero: Valve /datafeed/herodata hero_id 96 (Hoof Stomp, Double Edge, Retaliate, Stampede), 7.41f.

rules.name: Pipe of Insight
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Pipe of Insight: Barrier absorbs 425 magic damage on every nearby ally for 8 s; 20% magic resistance and an 8% aura. High-rank Centaurs against 3+ magic damage heroes: 49% of 69 games (27% otherwise), won 56% against 34%.

reason.en: {enemy} and other magic damage heroes are in their team: {item} shields your whole team from their spells
reason.uk: {enemy} та інші герої з магічною шкодою: {item} захищає від їхніх здібностей усю вашу команду

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: bracer 40% (3), vanguard 37% (7), helm_of_the_dominator 61% (8), magic_wand 59% (9), blade_mail 23% (13), soul_ring 24% (19), heart 64% (20), pipe 32% (21), crimson_guard 23% (22), pers 38% (23), lotus_orb 37% (24), aghanims_shard 60% (27), shivas_guard 35% (33), black_king_bar 38% (33), ultimate_scepter 42% (35).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 85.0%+: 20:00 11500 (40 games, 90.0%), 25:00 15500 (41 games, 87.8%), 30:00 18500 (77 games, 87.0%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold; points under 20 games left out.

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then lead the fights and take objectives with your team
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім ведіть бійки й беріть об'єкти разом із командою
